q: What were my total sales last month?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS total_sales FROM v_sales WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '{{last_month_from}}' AND '{{last_month_to}}'

q: Total sales this month
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS total_sales FROM v_sales WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '{{this_month_from}}' AND '{{today}}'

q: How much did I sell yesterday?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS total_sales FROM v_sales WHERE sale_date = '{{yesterday}}'

q: What is the revenue for this financial year?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM v_sales WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '{{this_fy_from}}' AND '{{today}}'

q: How many orders did we get last week?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_no) AS orders FROM v_sales WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '{{last_week_from}}' AND '{{last_week_to}}'

q: Total units sold in the last 7 days
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(qty), 3) AS units_sold FROM v_sales WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '{{d7_from}}' AND '{{today}}'

q: What were total expenses last month?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS total_expenses FROM v_expenses WHERE expense_date BETWEEN '{{last_month_from}}' AND '{{last_month_to}}'

q: How much did we purchase from suppliers this month?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(cost_total), 2) AS total_purchases FROM v_purchases WHERE purchase_date BETWEEN '{{this_month_from}}' AND '{{today}}'

q: What was the average order value last month?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(revenue) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_no), 0), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM v_sales WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '{{last_month_from}}' AND '{{last_month_to}}'

q: How much revenue came from Sundays in the last 30 days?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS sunday_revenue FROM v_sales WHERE weekday = 'Sunday' AND sale_date BETWEEN '{{d30_from}}' AND '{{today}}'

q: Top 5 products by revenue last month
sql: SELECT product_name, ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM v_sales WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '{{last_month_from}}' AND '{{last_month_to}}' GROUP BY sku, product_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

q: Top 10 products by units sold this month
sql: SELECT product_name, ROUND(SUM(qty), 3) AS units FROM v_sales WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '{{this_month_from}}' AND '{{today}}' GROUP BY sku, product_name ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 10

q: Which 5 products made the most profit in the last 30 days?
sql: SELECT product_name, ROUND(SUM(gross_profit), 2) AS gross_profit FROM v_sales WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '{{d30_from}}' AND '{{today}}' GROUP BY sku, product_name ORDER BY gross_profit DESC LIMIT 5

q: Bottom 5 products by revenue last month, among products that sold
sql: SELECT product_name, ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM v_sales WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '{{last_month_from}}' AND '{{last_month_to}}' GROUP BY sku, product_name ORDER BY revenue ASC LIMIT 5

q: Top 3 named customers by revenue in the last 90 days
sql: SELECT customer_name, ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM v_sales WHERE customer_name IS NOT NULL AND sale_date BETWEEN '{{d90_from}}' AND '{{today}}' GROUP BY customer_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3

q: Which supplier did we buy the most from this financial year?
sql: SELECT supplier_name, ROUND(SUM(cost_total), 2) AS total_purchases FROM v_purchases WHERE purchase_date BETWEEN '{{this_fy_from}}' AND '{{today}}' GROUP BY supplier_name ORDER BY total_purchases DESC LIMIT 1

q: Top 5 best selling products in Snacks & Biscuits last month
sql: SELECT product_name, ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM v_sales WHERE category = 'Snacks & Biscuits' AND sale_date BETWEEN '{{last_month_from}}' AND '{{last_month_to}}' GROUP BY sku, product_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

q: What is my single best selling product by units this financial year?
sql: SELECT product_name, ROUND(SUM(qty), 3) AS units FROM v_sales WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '{{this_fy_from}}' AND '{{today}}' GROUP BY sku, product_name ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 1

q: Sales by category last month
sql: SELECT category, ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM v_sales WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '{{last_month_from}}' AND '{{last_month_to}}' GROUP BY category ORDER BY revenue DESC

q: Units sold by category this month
sql: SELECT category, ROUND(SUM(qty), 3) AS units FROM v_sales WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '{{this_month_from}}' AND '{{today}}' GROUP BY category ORDER BY units DESC

q: Expenses by category for last month
sql: SELECT category, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS amount FROM v_expenses WHERE expense_date BETWEEN '{{last_month_from}}' AND '{{last_month_to}}' GROUP BY category ORDER BY amount DESC

q: How many products do I have in each category?
sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS products FROM v_products GROUP BY category ORDER BY products DESC

q: Stock value by category
sql: SELECT category, ROUND(SUM(stock_value_at_cost), 2) AS stock_value FROM v_products GROUP BY category ORDER BY stock_value DESC

q: Revenue by weekday for the last 90 days
sql: SELECT weekday, ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM v_sales WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '{{d90_from}}' AND '{{today}}' GROUP BY weekday ORDER BY revenue DESC

q: Which products are low on stock or out of stock?
sql: SELECT name, stock_on_hand FROM v_products WHERE stock_status IN ('low', 'out') ORDER BY stock_on_hand

q: Which products are out of stock?
sql: SELECT name FROM v_products WHERE stock_status = 'out' ORDER BY name

q: How much stock of Sugar 1kg do I have?
sql: SELECT stock_on_hand FROM v_products WHERE name = 'Sugar 1kg'

q: What is the total value of my inventory?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(stock_value_at_cost), 2) AS inventory_value FROM v_products

q: Show dead stock with its value
sql: SELECT name, stock_value_at_cost FROM v_products WHERE stock_on_hand > 0 AND days_since_last_sale >= 90 ORDER BY stock_value_at_cost DESC

q: How many products are overstocked?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS overstocked_products FROM v_products WHERE stock_status = 'overstock'

q: List products that have fewer than 5 units in stock
sql: SELECT name, stock_on_hand FROM v_products WHERE stock_on_hand < 5 ORDER BY stock_on_hand

q: How many products in the Dairy & Bakery category are in stock right now?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS products_in_stock FROM v_products WHERE category = 'Dairy & Bakery' AND stock_on_hand > 0

q: What was my gross profit last month?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(gross_profit), 2) AS gross_profit FROM v_sales WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '{{last_month_from}}' AND '{{last_month_to}}'

q: Net profit last month
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(net_profit), 2) AS net_profit FROM v_daily_summary WHERE day BETWEEN '{{last_month_from}}' AND '{{last_month_to}}'

q: What is my profit margin percentage this month?
sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(gross_profit) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue), 0), 2) AS margin_pct FROM v_sales WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '{{this_month_from}}' AND '{{today}}'

q: Margin by category for the last 30 days
sql: SELECT category, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(gross_profit) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue), 0), 2) AS margin_pct FROM v_sales WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '{{d30_from}}' AND '{{today}}' GROUP BY category ORDER BY margin_pct DESC

q: Which category is the most profitable this financial year?
sql: SELECT category, ROUND(SUM(gross_profit), 2) AS gross_profit FROM v_sales WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '{{this_fy_from}}' AND '{{today}}' GROUP BY category ORDER BY gross_profit DESC LIMIT 1

q: Gross profit by month for the last 6 months
sql: SELECT month, ROUND(SUM(gross_profit), 2) AS gross_profit FROM v_sales WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '{{m6_from}}' AND '{{today}}' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

q: What are the selling price and cost price of Aashirvaad Atta 5kg?
sql: SELECT selling_price, cost_price FROM v_products WHERE name = 'Aashirvaad Atta 5kg'

q: How much profit did Milma Milk 500ml make last month?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(gross_profit), 2) AS gross_profit FROM v_sales WHERE product_name = 'Milma Milk 500ml' AND sale_date BETWEEN '{{last_month_from}}' AND '{{last_month_to}}'

q: Compare sales this month and last month
sql: SELECT 'this month' AS period, ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM v_sales WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '{{this_month_from}}' AND '{{today}}' UNION ALL SELECT 'last month', ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) FROM v_sales WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '{{last_month_from}}' AND '{{last_month_to}}'

q: Sales this week versus last week
sql: SELECT 'this week' AS period, ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM v_sales WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '{{this_week_from}}' AND '{{today}}' UNION ALL SELECT 'last week', ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) FROM v_sales WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '{{last_week_from}}' AND '{{last_week_to}}'

q: Month by month revenue for the last 3 months
sql: SELECT month, ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM v_sales WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '{{m3_from}}' AND '{{today}}' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

q: Compare last month's gross profit with the month before
sql: SELECT 'last month' AS period, ROUND(SUM(gross_profit), 2) AS gross_profit FROM v_sales WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '{{last_month_from}}' AND '{{last_month_to}}' UNION ALL SELECT 'month before', ROUND(SUM(gross_profit), 2) FROM v_sales WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '{{prev_month_from}}' AND '{{prev_month_to}}'

q: What is the percentage growth in revenue of last month over the month before?
sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN sale_date BETWEEN '{{last_month_from}}' AND '{{last_month_to}}' THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN sale_date BETWEEN '{{prev_month_from}}' AND '{{prev_month_to}}' THEN revenue ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN sale_date BETWEEN '{{prev_month_from}}' AND '{{prev_month_to}}' THEN revenue ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS growth_pct FROM v_sales WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '{{prev_month_from}}' AND '{{last_month_to}}'

q: Which category grew the most in rupees last month compared to the month before?
sql: SELECT category, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN sale_date BETWEEN '{{last_month_from}}' AND '{{last_month_to}}' THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN sale_date BETWEEN '{{prev_month_from}}' AND '{{prev_month_to}}' THEN revenue ELSE 0 END), 2) AS revenue_growth FROM v_sales WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '{{prev_month_from}}' AND '{{last_month_to}}' GROUP BY category ORDER BY revenue_growth DESC LIMIT 1
